exams.name: Initial
exams.syllabus: Trinity Classical / Acoustic Guitar syllabus. Lists read from the board's official repertoire pages.
comps: Face-to-face: 3 pieces at 22 each (66; fluency & accuracy 7, technical facility 7, communication & interpretation 8) + technical work 14 (scales, arpeggios, broken chords, exercises, chord sequences/cadences) + supporting tests 20 = 100. Initial-G5: any two of sight reading, aural, improvisation, musical knowledge (10 each). G6-8: sight reading (10) plus aural or improvisation (10). Distinction 87-100, Merit 75-86, Pass 60-74, Below Pass 1 45-59, Below Pass 2 0-44; per piece D 19-22, M 16-18, P 13-15. No need to pass every section. UCAS points G6 8/10/12, G7 12/14/16, G8 18/24/30 (pass/merit/distinction). Digital technical-work pathway: 3 pieces at 22 (66) + technical work 14 (set A or set B) + overall performance 20 = 100; no supporting tests. Digital repertoire-only pathway: 4 pieces at 25 each = 100.

3 pieces freely chosen from the single list for the grade (no groups); all published in standard notation and TAB. Duets at Initial-G5 (play upper part; lower part live or Trinity recording). Selected pieces use backing tracks (optional or compulsory as listed; candidate supplies playback equipment). Own composition may replace one piece (0.5-1 min at Initial to 3.5-5 min at G8; stave notation G6-8). Observe all repeats, D.C./D.S.; memory optional; no metronome. Teachers may help tune to G5; electronic tuners allowed at all grades.

Digital exams are filmed in one continuous take and uploaded. Technical-work pathway: 3 pieces, technical work (set A or set B, from memory), overall performance mark, no supporting tests. Repertoire-only pathway: 4 pieces. Duets (to G5), backing tracks and own composition allowed.
sections: Prepare all, examiner selects; from memory; plectrum, fingers or both. Scales to the 5th, asc/desc, mf, min q=60: C and G major, D minor; arpeggios C and G major, D minor.
Approx 1 grade lower; 30 s prep; standard notation, plectrum optional. C major, 2/4, crotchets/minims, mf, 1st position, open basses, even picking.

Choose two of: sight reading, aural, improvisation, musical knowledge. Aural (4-bar major melody): clap pulse on 3rd playing; forte/piano; legato/staccato; highest or lowest of first 3 notes. Improv (stylistic/motivic/harmonic): 4 bars, C major, chords I, V. Musical knowledge (on own pieces): note names, durations, clefs, signatures, basic terms.

Pasek & Paul: Songwriting duo behind The Greatest Showman, Dear Evan Hansen and La La Land lyrics.
Porter: American songwriter of Kiss Me, Kate and many witty standards.
Withers: American soul singer-songwriter famous for Lean on Me and Ain't No Sunshine.
King: Composer of songs for young singers.
Howard: Composer of pieces in a string method book; identity uncertain.
Arlen & Harburg: American songwriter best known for The Wizard of Oz songs, written with lyricist Yip Harburg.
Lecuona: Cuban pianist-composer famous for Afro-Cuban and Spanish-style piano music.
Williams: American composer famous for film scores including Star Wars, Jaws and Schindler's List.
